description: I am very clear about my wants / needs and will communicate them clearly #communicationskills #selflove #intentionalliving
transcript: I do not expect any person place or thing to read my mind. I am very clear and very direct with what my expectations are and what my needs are. I do not spend in circles waiting for others to read my mind. I go after what I need because my life belongs to me. I am not waiting for anyone to tell me yes. I will always tell myself yes and always move towards what I need.
